brief63001#6.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><ac(1)>Looks like we have quite a few new faces.
I'm this ship's captain, Eyphar Sinapus.
I look forward to working with you.

brief63001#7.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Now, I will explain this ship's<im(1)> course
and our operational plan.

brief63001#8.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>The #c[BE5050]Zeon remnant#c forces that stole the
Gundam were spotted heading north by
patrol craft.

brief63001#9.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Considering their subsequent course,
remaining propellant, and their
cooperation with #c[BE5050]Giganos#c forces,

brief63001#10.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>we have concluded that their destination<im(2)>
must be the #c[BE5050]Giganos#c base near where they
were spotted.

brief63001#11.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>The #c[BE5050]Unified Empire of Giganos#c is a
Moon-based military regime, and lately its
invasion of Earth has begun in earnest.

brief63001#12.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>And as you know, they currently occupy<im(7)>
bases all across the surface.
This base is one of them.

brief63001#13.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>We'll join the #c[5E8FD8]UCE Metal Armor unit#c<im(9)><im(6)>
deployed in this area and carry out the
#c[F07141]Gundam recapture operation#c.

brief63001#14.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Also, an acting platoon leader will be
assigned to help the injured Capt. Burning.<of(1)>
They're set to join us during the operation.

brief63001#15.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>That is all. Everyone, get some rest until
the operation starts. Things are going to
get busy.

brief63033#2.value:
<op(56,1)><sp(2)>I am Linda Plato of the #c[5E8FD8]Dragonar transport
unit#c. I look forward to working with you.

brief63033#3.value:
<op(56,1)><sp(2)>As someone familiar with the operational
area, I will present the mission briefing.

brief63033#4.value:
<op(56,1)><sp(2)>The first objective for this<im(1)> operation
is the #c[BE5050]Giganos#c forward base.<tr(1)>

brief63033#5.value:
<op(56,1)><sp(2)>Reports indicate #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c may be
stored near the base facilities, so we will
conduct an operation to secure the area.

brief63033#6.value:
<op(56,1)><sp(2)>Please #c[F07141]destroy all base facilities<im(4)>#c to shut
down the base's functions.

brief63033#7.value:
<op(56,1)><sp(2)>The #c[5E8FD8]Dragonar Team#c you are to join has
already begun attacking ahead, so please
work together with them on this mission.

brief63033#8.value:
<op(56,1)><sp(2)>That concludes my briefing.
Let us begin the operation.

m6021#6.value: <op()><sp(20)>All right! Bring it on, all of you!<ab(600)><ed()>

m6021#7.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Don't get scared and run away from
us!<ab(200)><ed()>

m6021#9.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Come on, quit fooling around and
introduce yourselves!<ab(300)><ed()>

m6021#11.value:
<sp(20)>Warrant Officer Kaine Wakaba and
two others,<ab(300)>

m6021#12.value:
<sp(20)>are joining the Albion team for the
mission to pursue Gundam Unit 2!<ab(200)>

m6021#15.value:
<op()><sp(20)>The D-weapons... The ones from the
military manual...<ab(100)>

m6021#16.value:
<sp(20)>The latest Metal Armors, brought by a
scientist who defected from Giganos...<ab(700)>

m6021#17.value:
<sp(20)>I'm no expert on machines, but they
seem unlike any other Metal Armor.<ab(500)><ed()>

m6021#18.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Enemy Metal Armors are heading your
way.<ab(300)><ed()>

m6021#22.value: <op()><sp(20)>We are in the middle of a mission!<ab(400)><ed()>

m6021#25.value: <op()><sp(20)>You know it! Leave it to me!<ab(100)><ed()>

m6021#27.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Sensor contact south of the combat
zone.<ab(400)><ed()>

m6021#30.value:
<op()><sp(20)>We are receiving a surrender signal
from the enemy.<ab(200)><ed()>

m6021#32.value: <op()><sp(20)>Hey, you guys still at it over there?<ab(200)><ed()>

m6021#34.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Word just came in that the transport
fleet was found.<ab(500)>

m6021#35.value: <sp(20)>They pulled a fast one on us...<ab(300)>

m6021#36.value:
<sp(20)>We must resume the pursuit. Return at
once.<ab(500)><ed()>

m6021#37.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Upgrade parts for the D-series have
arrived for the Dragonar Team.<ab(500)>

m6021#38.value:
<sp(20)>They can go Custom type anytime.
Come to the hangar if you'd like.<ab(300)><ed()>

m6021#39.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Woo-hoo! A beauty like you should
be customizing me, not the Dragonar!<ab(100)><ed()>

m6021#40.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Ah, excuse him. Please just ignore
what he says.<ab(0)><ed()>

m6021#42.value: <sp(20)>We're in a hurry. Get back here now!<ab(100)><ed()>

m6021#44.value:
<sp(20)>You can acquire the module by
locking on and approaching it.<ab(3000)><ed()>

m6021#46.value:
<on()><sp(20)>What took you so long?! We were
about to take 'em all out ourselves!<ab(0)><off()>

m6021#47.value:
<on()><sp(20)>Look who's talking. You were just
fleeing with an enemy on your tail.<ab(0)><off()>

m6021#48.value:
<on()><sp(20)>Man... maybe I really should've taken
the reward and quit the military.<ab(0)><off()>

brief63034#2.value:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>We've made contact with enemy transports.<im(1)>
One of those #c[BE5050]transport ships#c should be
carrying #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c.<tr(1)>

brief63034#3.value:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>We can't afford to let it get away here.
#c[F07141]Destroy all<im(5)> transport ships#c and smoke out
#c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c!

brief63034#4.value:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>There's also a chance #c[BE5050]Giganos#c forces<im(6)> will
attack.<of(1)> Stay sharp out there.

m6022#4.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Unit 2 is inside one of them!
Destroy them and find it!<ab(500)><ed()>

m6022#9.value:
<op()><sp(20)>A dummy? They went to a lot of
trouble.<ab(300)><ed()>

m6022#11.value:
<op()><sp(20)>We just have to smash every last one
of 'em!<ab(400)><ed()>

m6022#17.value:
<op()><sp(20)>An enemy ship is attempting to
escape!<ab(400)><ed()>

m6022#18.value: <op()><sp(20)>This is bad! Don't let it get away!<ab(400)><ed()>

m6022#22.value:
<op()><sp(20)>...That reaction speed! Is my opponent
the "White Devil of the Federation"?!<ab(700)><ed()>

m6022#24.value:
<sp(20)>To think that after the war ended,
I'd end up fighting like this...<ab(700)><ed()>

m6022#25.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Is that a Gundam? No... it's weaker...
Looks like a mass-production unit.<ab(500)>

m6022#26.value:
<sp(20)>All that in a mass-production unit...
A true ace of the One Year War...<ab(500)><ed()>

m6022#27.value:
<op()><sp(20)>What are you doing, in the middle of
a tactical-level fight like this?!<ab(200)><ed()>

m6022#28.value:
<op()><sp(20)>You're an officer too! If you're no
mere grunt, look at the bigger picture!<ab(600)><ed()>

m6022#31.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Curse you! I, Anavel Gato,
have waited three long years!<ab(400)>

m6022#32.value:
<sp(20)>I will never let mindless fools like
you stand in the way of our ideals!<ab(500)><ed()>

m6022#34.value:
<op()><sp(20)>We shall seize the true liberation
of Spacenoids!<ab(400)>

m6022#35.value:
<sp(20)>From their wicked bondage, by my
sword of justice!<ab(600)><ed()>

m6022#38.value:
<op()><sp(20)>...Impressive! To think the rotten UCE
has someone like this!<ab(700)><ed()>

m6022#39.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Heh heh heh heh heh, shall we get
started?!<ab(300)><ed()>

m6022#41.value:
<sp(20)>Whatever!
Come and get it, you UCE morons!<ab(500)><ed()>

m6022#42.value: <op()><sp(20)>Well then, let's take care of them.<ab(400)><ed()>

m6022#45.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Leave Unit 2 to the others. Right now,
focus on the enemies before you.<ab(700)><ed()>

m6022#46.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Heh! That went down easier than I
thought!<ab(400)><ed()>

m6022#50.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Got carried away, huh... That's enough
for today!<ab(500)><ed()>

m6022#51.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Tch, any more of this is trouble.
Boys! We're pulling out!<ab(300)><ed()>

m6022#54.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Captain Sinapus, sorry to keep you
waiting.<ab(200)>

m6022#55.value:
<sp(20)>I am Captain Amuro Ray, temporarily
transferred from the Ra Cailum.<ab(400)><ed()>

m6022#56.value:
<op()><sp(20)>Glad you made it. Just as I'd expect
from a Newtype pilot.<ab(300)>

m6022#57.value:
<sp(20)>Without you, Captain, this ship was at
risk too, let alone retaking Unit 2.<ab(300)>

m6022#58.value:
<sp(20)>Once you land, please report to the
briefing room.<ab(600)><ed()>

m6022#60.value:
<sp(20)>You can acquire the module by
locking on and approaching it.<ab(5000)><ed()>

<on()><sp(20)>Amuro Ray?!
Captain Amuro Ray from White Base?!<ab(0)><off()>

m6022#69.value:
<on()><sp(20)>I'm Captain Amuro of Londo Bell now.
Anyway, focus on the enemy at hand.<ab(0)><off()>

m6022#72.value:
<on()><sp(20)>What did you say? That bastard Gon
Jem?!<ab(0)><off()>

m6022#73.value:
<on()><sp(20)>Guhahaha! You from Solomon! Get out

m6022#74.value:
<on()><sp(20)>We'll take real good care of you

m6022#75.value:

Go wherever you like, just get lost!<ab(0)><off()>

brief63169#0.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Now that #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c has slipped away,<im(1)>
we are exposed to a nuclear threat.

brief63169#1.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>That is not all. If the Gundam Development
Project becomes public,<im(4)> the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c will be
placed in a very difficult spot.

brief63169#2.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>We must recover #c[BE5050]Unit 2#c<im(6)> no matter what.
This ship will continue its pursuit.

brief63169#3.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Captain Amuro will take command in the
field<im(9)> as assistant to Captain Burning.

brief63169#4.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Capt. Burning, work with Capt. Amuro<im(10)>
and oversee operations and all mobile
forces from the bridge.

brief63169#5.value:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>I expect each of you to continue
giving your best to this mission.

brief63200#2.value:
<sp(0)><im(1)>It is well known that the #c[BE5050]Unified Empire
of Giganos#c, founded after the last war, still
resists Earth, claiming independence.

brief63200#3.value:
<sp(0)>Furthermore, in the recent Torrington Base
attack,<im(2)> joint operations conducted with
#c[BE5050]Zeon remnant#c forces were confirmed.

brief63200#4.value:
<sp(0)>The #c[BE5050]former Principality of Zeon#c, which
sought space emigrant autonomy, and the
#c[BE5050]Giganos Empire#c<im(3)> share ideological ground,

brief63200#5.value:
<sp(0)>and this is presumed to be what lies
behind their alliance.

brief63200#6.value:
<sp(0)>However, their choosing to operate jointly
at this time suggests another aim as well,
and further investigation will be required.

brief63200#7.value:
<sp(0)>Regarding this series of incidents,
we will report further as new
information becomes available.
